g.text: PF-L. Next-day error of W1, persistence and climatology on all complete dates (pooled, three primary stations)
Evidence A cases (overall evidence). Panel directive 2026-10-25: all four panels show all complete dates; values locked in spec/FROZEN_PF-L_metrics.json. Results on dates
W1 = saved neural-only next-day output of the deployed model (website scorecard cohort, NAIA / Sangley Point / Science Garden, target dates 2021-11-16 to 2024-12-30); persistence = issue-day
observation; climatology = station × month mean 2015-01-01 to 2020-10-14. Truth: raw PAGASA observations; a case is used when observation, W1, persistence and climatology all exist. Error bars: 95%
paired circular block bootstrap over target dates (14-day blocks, 2,000 resamples). Run panel-v3-20261025T125659Z-284767.
